description:
We are a small, close-knit team of engineers building the experiences that let people view, place, and share 3D content across Apple platforms, including Apple Vision Pro. We believe 3D should feel as effortless as opening a photo, and we sweat the details that make that true. Join us to shape how millions of people explore and interact with the world around them in a new design space, and to build the frameworks that other teams across Apple build on.

Description
This role focuses on designing and building the user-facing 3D and spatial experiences, and the front-end architecture beneath them, that bring digital content into people's physical world. You will combine strong UI engineering with real-time 3D, working closely with design and partner teams to ship polished, performant, and scalable features. You will also help define how shared, multi-user spatial experiences come to life.

Responsibilities
Design and build interactive 3D and spatial user interfaces that feel natural, responsive, and delightful across Apple platforms.
Develop scalable, maintainable front-end components that multiple platforms and product surfaces can share.
Contribute to multi-user experiences that let people view and interact with the same 3D content together.
Collaborate with design, product, and partner engineering teams to turn novel AR/VR interaction concepts into shipping features.
Profile and optimize real-time rendering and UI performance to maintain smooth frame rates and low latency.
Help build and evolve the APIs that enable spatial experiences.
Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, and share what you learn with the team.

Minimum qualifications
2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production applications or frameworks.
Proficiency in Swift, Objective-C, or C++, with experience building user interfaces on Apple platforms.
Hands-on experience with real-time 3D graphics or 3D UI, such as games, game engines, or 3D frameworks. Professional, academic, or personal projects all count.
Demonstrated ability to own features from design through shipping.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience using AI coding tools as part of your regular workflow, with the ability to critically review, verify, and debug AI-generated code.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with scalable front-end architecture, including modular, reusable components shared across products.
Experience building multi-user or multiplayer experiences, including state synchronization and shared sessions.
Familiarity with Apple frameworks, platforms, and design principles (e.g. SwiftUI, UIKit, RealityKit, ARKit, SharePlay).
Passion for UI/UX and for exploring the design space of AR/VR and spatial computing.
Curiosity about how generative AI is changing software development, and eagerness to explore, adopt, and share new AI-assisted workflow practices with the team.
Experience partnering effectively with design, product, and other cross-functional teams to ship high-quality work.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
Interest in API design for frameworks used by developers.
